import random

def generate_test_case():
    # Generate the length of the array based on the constraints
    n = random.randint(2, 100)

    a = random.randint(-500, 500)
    target = random.randint(-500, 500)
    b = target - a
    
    exclusive = set([a, b])
    numbers = [a, b]
    
    for _ in range(n):
        select = random.randint(-500, 500)
        if select not in exclusive:
            numbers.append(select)
            exclusive.add(target-select)
            exclusive.add(select)

    return sorted(numbers), target
